items.name: Villamar Cubing I 2025
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTExNjQyLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--8d86db63efca205e3f25ff5ac80261272b8c7978/IMG_4793.jpeg)

Villamar Cubing I 2025 es una competencia oficial de la WCA que se llevará a cabo en Comayagua, la capital colonial de Honduras. El evento está abierto a competidores de todas las nacionalidades y tiene como objetivo promover el crecimiento del speedcubing en la región.

__________________________________________________________________________________________________________________


Villamar Cubing I 2025 is a WCA competition taking place in Comayagua, the colonial capital of Honduras. The event is open to competitors of all nationalities and aims to promote the growth of speedcubing in the region.

items.name: QC Speedcubing Open 2025

venue.name: Robinsons Magnolia
venue.address: Aurora Blvd, corner Doña Hemady St, Quezon City, 1111 Metro Manila

items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTE1NzE3LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--217a24da4eae50b86bad3e8edb668a7f5f61e8ee/91baeb65-94ac-4934-a044-41b138750f82.jpg)

In cooperation with **MNMCS**, **CSJDM cubers**, and **RPM cubers**, we are pleased to announce the **QC Speedcubing Open 2025**, which will take place at Robinsons Magnolia on August 31, 2025.

The competition features the following events: 2x2, 4x4, 3x3 BLD, Pyraminx, Clock, Skewb, and finally, the competition's main event, 3x3.
